description: Zone inondable - SDRIF-E is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Région Île-de-France, L'Institut Paris Region. Donnée surfacique du poste de légende "Zone pouvant présenter un risque d'inondation". Suite à un problème technique, les données sont fournies au format shapefile en pièce jointe. Coverage: Région Île-de-France, L'Institut Paris Region. The publisher named on the listing is Région Île-de-France, L'Institut Paris Region. Its keywords include amenagement-du-territoire, sdrif-e, sdrif-environnemental, geoidf, idg, cadre-de-vie-environnement. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2026-04-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
